notes.title: Character Creator Release Date!
notes.notes:
[h3]🌷Exciting News for Pixelart Character Creator!🌷[/h3][p][/p][p]I'm thrilled to announce that my Pixelart Character Creator is entering its final phase!
I'm beyond excited to share the official release date with you all!🥰[/p][p]
[b]✨Release date: 19/09/2025[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Get ready to craft unique characters for your adventures! Below is a sneak peek at the features available on launch. I’m already working on more updates, so stay tuned for even more customization options in the future![/p][p][/p][p]🛠️[b]Features at Launch:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]2 Character Types:[/b] Choose your character's vibe![/p][/*][*][p][b]10 Vibrant Colors:[/b] Customize skin tones for each character type.[/p][/*][*][p][b]20 Eye Styles:[/b] From sparkling to soulful, pick the perfect gaze.[/p][/*][*][p][b]20 Beards & Mustaches:[/b] Add some rustic charm or keep it clean-shaven.[/p][/*][*][p][b]20 Mouth Expressions:[/b] Show off your character's personality, from grins to smirks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]40 Hairstyles:[/b] 20 unique styles per character type for that perfect look.[/p][/*][*][p][b]40 Clothing Options:[/b] 20 outfits per character type, from overalls to cozy sweaters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pants, Accessories & More:[/b] Complete your character's style with extra flair![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support, and I can’t wait to see the amazing characters you create!💖[/p]
